title: Dismiss is offered on a receipt-less row its own turn is still handing off (human prompt / Engram promoted row)
outcome: A queued row that the current turn still owns during its hand-off is not classified as settled delivery history and offers no Dismiss. This covers a human prompt with engram_ordinary_handoff set before provider enqueue (human_prompts.rs:724-730), and an Engram-bound promoted row kept queued across the off-lock admission and WAL window (turn_dispatch.rs:323-330). The fix excludes the turn-owned row (for example the human_prompt_turn owner, or promoted_message_index == active_turn_start_message_count while Active or Approval) from unreceipted_queued_prompt_is_history and from cancel_queued_prompt's history path, or refuses cancel for it, so a provably never-handed-over prompt is not recorded as Ambiguous. Covered by a test for a row in that window. Low from the Claude reviewer (delegation-9bf35347) of the historical-queue-row fix, round 2. The outcome there is conservative: no re-send, and Active status keeps the indicator and thread-action guard.
acceptance: Dismiss is offered on a receipt-less row its own turn is still handing off (human prompt / Engram promoted row) is done
